messages.raw: Hey, I know a few Dungeon tricks.
messages.text: Hey, I know a few Dungeon tricks.
messages.zh: 嘿,我懂几招地牢里的门道。

messages.context: 竞选室首次或随机对话
messages.raw: If you vote for me I'll teach you!
messages.text: If you vote for me I'll teach you!

messages.context: 竞选室首次或随机对话
messages.raw: You merely adopted the Dungeons, I was born in them, molded by them.
messages.text: You merely adopted the Dungeons, I was born in them, molded by them.
messages.zh: 你不过是学会了闯地牢,我却生在地牢,长在地牢。

messages.context: 竞选室首次或随机对话
messages.raw: I used to be a Dungeon adventurer, until I took an arrow to the elbow.
messages.text: I used to be a Dungeon adventurer, until I took an arrow to the elbow.
messages.gloss: 一次性 Skyrim 梗；原文是手肘,不是膝盖。
messages.zh: 我以前也是个地牢冒险者,直到手肘中了一箭。

messages.raw: §fAll this paperwork is making me hungry.
messages.text: All this paperwork is making me hungry.
messages.zh: 处理这一堆文书,都把我弄饿了。

note:
身份: 热爱地牢冒险的市长候选人。
关系: 给选民传授地牢诀窍,会到花园求食。
口吻: 洒脱,嫌公务耽误冒险。
性格: 怀念地牢生活,不爱文书工作。
禁用: 不凭空添加地牢奖励,不硬塞时事梗。
